summary.text: Travis Simms is a Connecticut state representative serving Norwalk and sits on the Appropriations, Judiciary and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Norwalk, he was a member of the Norwalk Common Council representing South Norwalk beginning in 2009, where he served as Minority Leader.
His page describes him as a two-time world champion boxer.
He lives in Norwalk with his family.
